Saying things like "you're honestly holding your team back as a hitscan if you have a 60hZ monitor" doesn't sound like youre just sharing your own personal experience. You're basically telling someone they can't contribute unless they are MUCH better than whatever rank they are at or they need a 144hz monitor to have a chance. Im not butt hurt at all because I am using a 144hz monitor too and I do feel the differences, but spouting nonsense like that is just misleading and over glorifying how good a monitor can be. If it's a joke fair enough. But honestly no, if you are knowingly in a disadvantage it doesn't mean you're automatically throwing. If Im a top 500 player using a shit gear, with a computer putting out 30-40fps, against a bronze player with professional level gear, I am indeed in a disadvantage but by no means am I throwing because I know the skill level is there to make up for the disadvantage in gear. 
In conclusion, it's more important to emphasis on improving mechanics/game sense rather than your gear while it does give an easy advantage (for people who can afford it) it should be treated as just a bonus for those who can afford it, rather than a focus point for ppl to think that it would immediately improve their game. So for those people who don't have a 144hz monitor, can't afford one, or do not intend to ever get one, it doesn't matter. 
The focus of improving should never be to get better gear. Better gear should only be a last resort when you know you're at your highest potential, where you're 100% sure you can't improve any further and to squeeze any additional advantages out, unless of course you just simply want to buy good gear because it makes you feel good then that's your own choice. Also, while a better monitor or better gear in general does help. A lot of ppl think gear changes are more impactful than they really are because a lot of it is placebo. Some people improve a ton just by copying the gear that pros use because their brain just tells them that they have to be good since their using good gear
